facts.fact: The Minister for Home Affairs told Parliament, tabling the 2024/25 estimates, that the ministry has installed a digital case file management information system, to be connected with the criminal justice institutions.
facts.system: digital case file management information system

facts.fact: The minister said that by April 2024 the Central Police Stations in 23 regions had been connected to the national broadband backbone and linked to the Office of the Director of Public Prosecutions, with police stations in other regions still being connected to the system; the article gives no total of stations.
facts.system: digital case file management information system

facts.fact: The minister described the 23 regional Central Police Stations as connected over the national broadband backbone and linked to the Director of Public Prosecutions' office, and other stations as being connected to the system; the article does not say that the case file is entered at the station when the case is opened.
facts.system: digital case file management information system

facts.fact: The minister said the Ministry of Home Affairs installed the digital case file management information system itself, in carrying out the Criminal Justice Commission's recommendations.
facts.system: digital case file management information system

facts.fact: The article gives no funding source or cost for the case file system; the TZS 40.5 billion in the ministry's 2024/25 budget is stated as for strengthening the ICT system, installing the biometric system and buying police radios.
facts.system: digital case file management information system
